svg.title: How one video becomes a dataset
svg.desc: Five steps: probe the video and extract audio with ffprobe and ffmpeg; run each tool in its own isolated uv environment or binary; normalize results to Parquet and retain tool output; validate and record status, manifest and provenance so valid results are reused; export an ELAN summary, with an HTML preview helper.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How one video becomes a dataset

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sequential: one video, one stage at a time. Valid earlier results are reused, failures are recorded, not hidden.
